svg.aria-label: 9 configurable agents: Product Owner, Team Lead, Architect, Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, Developer, QA Engineer, Security Engineer, DevOps. Default models: Dev roles default to claude-fable-5, QA to claude-opus-5, the rest to claude-sonnet-5. Change an agent: Change a model, tools or system prompt with the update_agent MCP tool or in the dashboard. The model routes execution: During /kickoff and /sprint, a subagent at the assigned model tier (fable/opus/sonnet/haiku) implements each ticket. Several agents per ticket: Since 2.0. The lead implements, supporters verify, QA needs every verdict. Roles and focus: In docs/REFERENCE.md (the agent team)
